id: title:brandonleung:keep per call fees at the served price

review.posthog_relevance: Supports the AI ingestion and billing subsystem, specifically the calculation and recovery of costs for AI-generated responses, ensuring accurate pricing and preventing incorrect price recovery for per-call fees.
review.reason: The change refactors the AI ingestion cost calculation by removing a local, duplicated `ModelCost` interface and delegating to shared types, while simultaneously correcting the pricing recovery logic. P1.F2.H4 demonstrates a substantive improvement by distinguishing between flat-fee and optional-pricing fields, adding conditional de-discounting to prevent incorrect price recovery.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of a bounded, substantive correctness improvement in a critical billing path. However, the actual financial impact and whether this prevents a specific production incident are not demonstrated by the code alone; the benefit is inferred from the implementation rather than observed. No tier assignment is performed for unrelated PRs.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a typed import and removes a local ModelCost interface, delegating to shared types.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses shared type definitions rather than duplicating them, supporting maintainability.

observations.behavior: Defines FLAT_FEE_FIELDS and OPTIONAL_PRICING_FIELDS, removing local optionalPricingFields and its loop, and adds conditional de-discounting logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Distinguishes between fields carried at served price and those de-discounted, preventing incorrect price recovery for per-call fees.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation and removes a comment, while retaining the core de-discounting and recovery logic.
